contentHtml:
In Rasayana and Vajikarana treatments the treated person feels rejuvenated, young, healthy, vigorous, and comfortable. Life span of the person might increase through this process. Your sexual power will increase considerably and you will be able to enjoy your life much better than before. We have very special treatment for aphrodisiacs. Diabetic patients normally lose their erection power and become helpless in fulfilling their sexual needs. We are happy to help you in such conditions. Many people lose their sex power in middle age, in some cases young people too lose their abilities. For this treatment the person must be accompanied by their spouse or partner. The treatment takes a minimum of 4 to 6 weeks. You can have your second honeymoon.
